senses.gloss:
mfn. (-लः-ला-लं)
1 Radical, proceeding from a root or origin.
2 Of pure blood, descended from a respectable and primitive family without any improper intermixture.
E.
मूल a root, and अण् aff.

mf. (-लिः-ली or -ली)
1 A lock of hair on the crown of the head.
2 Hair ornamented and braided round the head.
3 A diadem, a Tiara.
4 The head.
f. (-ली)
The earth.
E.
मूल the root or base, aff. इञ् or मूल a name, and इञ् aff. of descent, or मू to bind, लि aff., and the radical vowel changed.
